fullContentHtml:

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) will upload the SSC GD Result 2026 before 11th September 2026 at the official website ssc.gov.in. Along with result, the Authority also release selection list pdfs, cut off marks, write ups PDFs. The Result includes shortlisted candidates list separately for male and female candidates in PDF format. All the provisionally selected candidates will appear for the PET/PST (Physical Endurance Test/ Physical Standard Test), that scheduled will be also be uploaded at the official portal.

SSC GD Result 2026 Date

A total of 48,83,309 candidates who have sucessfully appeared for the SSC GD Constable Exam conducted from 27th April to 31st May in three shifts, are eagerly waiting for the release of ssc gd result. It is expected that the SSC GD Constable Result 2026 will be released in the 2nd week of September 2026 along with merit list pdfs. Recently, the Staff Selection Commission has uploaded the answer key along with response sheet for the candidates. Scroll down to get complete information related to the SSC GD Result 2026, Merit List PDF, Scorecard PDF.

SSC GD Result 2026 @ssc.gov.in

As per SSC GD Recruitment, a total of 25847 vacancy has been announced for Constable Posts in different forces such as BSF, CISF, CRPF, SSB, ITBP, AR and SSF. Currently, the recruitment is its in first stage, where candidates are waiting for the release of CBT Exam Result. SSC GD Constable Result 2026 PDF Download Link

The SSC GD Constable Result 2026 link will be activated in 2nd week of September 2026 at the official Staff Selection Commission website, ssc.gov.in. Candidates can visit the Results section, select the relevant SSC GD Constable examination notice, and download the PDF to check their roll number and qualification status. The result PDF generally contains the names or roll numbers of shortlisted candidates for PST/PET along with category-wise cut-off marks and write ups.

How to Check SSC GD Result 2026?

Candidates can download the SSC GD Result 2026 PDF from the results section of the official SSC website. The result PDF is expected to have the details of the candidates who are shortlisted for the next stage.

  1. Visit the official of Staff Selection Commission (SSC) website ssc.gov.in
  2. Go to Results section
  3. Select Constable-GD Exam category
  4. Find SSC GD Constable 2026 result link
  5. Open and download result PDF
  6. Press Ctrl + F on the keyboard
  7. Enter your roll number
  8. Check the status of SSC GD Result in the merit list pdf.

Details Includes SSC GD Constable Result PDF

The SSC GD Result PDF 2026 is the official document to check the candidates shortlisted after the CBT stage. The result document is generally used for verification of roll number and shortlisting status for the next stage. Candidates are required to check the following details in the result PDF:

  • Examination name
  • Roll number
  • Candidate name, if provided
  • Category details, where applicable
  • Shortlisting status
  • Cut-off information
  • Instructions for the next stage

SSC GD Cut Off 2026 for Force Wise

SSC GD Cut Off 2026 will be released with the CBT result and it will decide the shortlisting of the candidates for the next phase. The cut-off may vary according to category, gender, state/area, vacancies and performance of the candidates. Cut-off should be considered only after the official result is published by Staff Selection Commission. Candidates must not consider the unofficial expected cut-offs as the final qualifying marks.

SSC GD Vacancy 2026 for Male and Female Candidates

The SSC GD vacancies are announced separately for male and female candidates across BSF, CISF, CRPF, SSB, ITBP, AR, and SSF. A total of 23,467 SSC GD Constable vacancies are available for male candidates, while 2,020 vacancies are available for female candidates, making the overall total 25,487 vacancies. CISF has the highest number of vacancies for both male and female candidates, followed by CRPF.

SSC GD Result 2026 FAQs

Ques: Is SSC GD Result 2026 Out?

Ans: No, SSC GD Result 2026 not out yet. CBT and tentative answer-key objection process has been completed and the result is awaited now.

Ques: When will SSC GD result 2026 be out?

Ans: SSC GD Result 2026 is likely to be out before 11th September 2026. SSC has not announced any specific official result date yet.

Ques: What to do while waiting for the SSC GD Results?

Ans: Candidates are advised to start preparing for PET/PST while waiting for the result of the CBT. Shortlisted candidates would be required to meet the applicable physical requirements and qualify in the physical stage.

Ques: Will SSC GD cut-off be released along with the result?

Ans: The SSC GD Cut Off 2026 will be released for male and female separately along with result and write up at the official website ssc.gov.in.

Ques: Can I check my SSC GD score using the result PDF?

Ans: Yes, you can check your SSC GD marks in the result PDF. SSC provides marks and scorecard details separately via the candidate login portal.
